name: Crypto Flow Technology Limited
summary: Crypto Flow Technology Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the lottery business in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Big Data Centre Services, Online Game Business, Money Lending Business, and Lottery Business segments. It provides lottery-related technologies, systems, and solutions to the China Welfare Lottery Issuance Centre and China Sports Lottery Administration Centre. The company distributes online mobile games; and trades in lottery terminals and parts, as well as provides services and solutions for the distribution of lottery products. It also offers data analysis, storage, and ancillary administrative and consulting services, as well as money lending services. The company was formerly known as MelcoLot Limited and changed its name to Crypto Flow Technology Limited in September 2017. Crypto Flow Technology Limited is headquartered in Telegraph Bay, Hong Kong.
